🐲 Yooka-Laylee's Impossible Lair is getting a Switch 2 Definitive Edition!

Developer Playtonic Games has announced that Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition hits Nintendo Switch 2 on December 15, 2026. This 2D platformer (closer to Donkey Kong Country than the original Yooka-Laylee) gets improved performance/visuals — enhanced lighting, ambient occlusion, higher-fidelity textures, up to 120 FPS — plus the previously-DLC Trowzer's Top Tonic Pack built in.

🎁 If you own the original 2019 Switch game, the upgrade is FREE — just need a physical copy or the same Nintendo account used for your digital purchase.

🕐 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 8:09 PM GMT+3
📰 Source: Video Games Chronicle
👥 Developer: Playtonic Games
